notes: The active Thailand national-team roster contains 23 King's Cup 2026 squad players with permanent Player IDs.
National-team cumulative statistics now start from 2026-11-17, Thailand vs Tajikistan (King's Cup 2026 final), and do not include previously imported career totals.
Previously imported career national-team statistics are retained in each player's statisticsArchive and are not included in active totals.
Only senior FIFA International A Matches count. Youth teams and unofficial matches are excluded.

The baseline match recorded Thailand's 3-0 win: Supachok Sarachat 1 goal; Teerasak Poeiphimai 2 goals; Kakana Khamyok 1 assist. No assist is assigned to the two rebound/deflection sequences where the official report does not establish a credited assist.
Appearances are 1 only for starting players and substitutes explicitly confirmed in the FA Thailand report; unverified appearances remain null and display as —.
Future eligible matches add to these baseline totals. Club statistics remain separate and scoped to season 2026/27.

Player list order is based on the shirt number for the selected membership: national-team shirt number for national-team views and current-club shirt number for club views. Unverified club shirt numbers remain null and sort after numbered players.

Player photos and club crests are linked from their cited publisher/source pages. Missing or unverified player photos continue to use the neutral placeholder; do not infer or generate identity images.
Identity matching uses permanent Player ID and Club ID. Display names are localized; aliases are lookup hints only and never sufficient alone to auto-merge uncertain identities.

Portrait follow-up: Santiphap Channgom uses a CC0 1.0 Wikimedia Commons match photo; Oussama Thiangkham uses a Siamsport publisher-hosted editorial image; William Weidersjo uses a portrait credited by National Football Teams to SiebenW (reuse terms not stated). Uthai Thani crest URL replaced with direct 512x512 PNG from FootyLogos.

Eleven Thailand senior players shown on the user-provided 52nd King's Cup 2026 poster now use individually cropped portrait tiles from that poster. William Wedderburn's previously supplied image was removed after the user identified it as the wrong person; a neutral placeholder is retained pending a verified portrait. Suphanat Mueanta uses the official RB Omiya Ardija signing image.
